title: The Bee at the Beach
lines: Meg and her dad went to the beach.
They had a meal of peach and tea.
A bee sat on the last bit of peach.
Meg let the bee have it.
Then she went to sleep in the sun.
She had a dream of a green sea.
In the dream she had feet like a fish.
Then Meg got up and ran to the sea.
It was cold and green on her feet.
It was the best day at the beach.

questions.ask: What did Meg and her dad eat at the beach?
questions.listenFor: A meal of peach and tea. If they say just peach, ask what they drank.
She had feet like a fish and swam deep in a green sea. Listen for the fish feet, which is the fun part.

questions.ask: Do you think Meg did the right thing with the bee? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. Listen for a reason, like she gave up her last bit of peach, or bees can sting.
